svg.aria-label: Paired change from base in GSM8K, MATH-500, MMLU-Pro, HumanEval and ASan-30 root-cause accuracy for calibrated and norm-matched random edits across 14 models
svg.text: FIGURE · PUBLIC BENCHMARKS · 14 MODELS (0.8B TO 32.8B) · H100
Pooled over 14 models, calibrated 1.0x edits move each benchmark by about 2 points or less, like equal-size random edits
Each dot is a paired change from the unedited base on the same items (percentage points). Filled blue: Target-Shift-calibrated B2 + B3 edits at 1.0x. Orange ring: a random
direction orthogonal to the aligned one, with the same column support and the same Frobenius norm. A white halo marks a cell whose exact McNemar p survives Holm correction (70 cells, 0.05).
